record.question: Laltheri, a Sailo girl was the daughter of one of the most powerful chiefs named:
record.explanation: Answer C: Lalsavunga. Laltheri (Lalchawngpuii) is identified in Mizo historical research as the daughter of the Sailo chief Lalsavunga. The other three names do not match this identification. Independent source: Mizo Studies, Vol. V No. 2 (2016), https://mizostudiesmzu.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/Mizo-Studies-Vol.-V-No.-2-April-June.-2016.pdf . Independently reviewed worked solution, unofficial; the date-mismatched final key has not been registered or used as factual proof.
